requirements.title: CFI_deallocate has the ISO_Fortran_binding.h deallocation interface
requirements.definition: CFI_deallocate has the interface int CFI_deallocate(CFI_cdesc_t *dv) and deallocates memory for a descriptor-described object.

pending.CFI_deallocate-interface: C companion includes ISO_Fortran_binding.h, declares a CFI_cdesc_t pointer, and compiles an ordinary CFI_deallocate call that returns int.

requirements.title: CFI_deallocate actual argument must describe an object allocated by Fortran allocation mechanisms
requirements.definition: The descriptor address shall describe the object, the object shall have been allocated using the same mechanism as Fortran ALLOCATE, and a pointer object shall be associated with a target satisfying Fortran DEALLOCATE success conditions.

pending.CFI_deallocate-descriptor-address: Positive C companion passes the same descriptor pointer previously returned from CFI_establish and CFI_allocate; a null descriptor argument is a nonconforming source-control negative without required diagnosis.
pending.CFI_deallocate-fortran-allocation-mechan: Allocate an allocatable descriptor only through CFI_allocate, store a nondefault value through CFI_address, then call CFI_deallocate; C malloc storage is never passed as a deallocation positive control.
pending.CFI_deallocate-pointer-target-deallocata: Pointer positive control uses CFI_allocate on a pointer descriptor, writes a sentinel value through CFI_address, then CFI_deallocate; alias-to-static-storage mutation is nonconforming and carries no required diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: Successful CFI_deallocate releases storage and nulls base_addr
requirements.definition: Successful CFI_deallocate uses the Fortran DEALLOCATE mechanism and makes the descriptor base_addr member a null pointer.

pending.CFI_deallocate-success-base-null: C companion establishes and allocates a rank-one int descriptor with bounds {1}:{3}, writes 41 through CFI_address before deallocation, calls CFI_deallocate, and asserts CFI_SUCCESS plus base_addr equal to NULL.

requirements.title: Detected CFI_deallocate errors preserve the descriptor
requirements.definition: After a detected CFI_deallocate error, the C descriptor is not modified.

pending.CFI_deallocate-detected-error-preserves-: C companion establishes a descriptor with CFI_attribute_allocatable, valid rank one, CFI_type_int, and base_addr equal to NULL, snapshots base_addr, elem_len, version, rank, attribute, type, and every dim lower_bound, extent, and sm member, calls CFI_deallocate, and asserts the returned indicator is CFI_ERROR_BASE_ADDR_NULL from the non-null base required for deallocation plus every snapshotted descriptor member is unchanged.

requirements.title: CFI_deallocate returns an error indicator
requirements.definition: The result of CFI_deallocate is an error indicator.

Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across three rounds; success paths and isolated named-error conditions are planned as C companion programs with exact results.
